components.name: View Tabs
components.description: Compact Monitor/Performance/Risk navigation with a local selected rail.
components.html: <nav class="ds-view-tabs" aria-label="Dashboard view"><button class="ds-chip" type="button" aria-selected="true">Monitor</button><button class="ds-chip" type="button" aria-selected="false">Performance</button><button class="ds-chip" type="button" aria-selected="false">Risk</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-view-tabs { display:flex; gap:2px; padding:3px; background:var(--surface-2); border:1px solid var(--ring); border-radius:5px; } .ds-chip { border:0; border-radius:3px; padding:5px 10px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); font:700 10px/1.2 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:.02em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-chip:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--s1); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-chip[aria-selected="true"] { background:var(--surface-solid); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.18); } .ds-chip:active { background:var(--surface-solid); }

components.name: Icon Control
components.description: Small settings/theme/export control with an inline SVG glyph.
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; border:1px solid var(--ring); border-radius:6px; padding:7px 11px; background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink-2); font:400 14px/1.5 "Trebuchet MS",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:color 120ms, border-color 120ms, background-color 120ms; } .ds-icon { width:14px; height:14px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color:var(--ink); border-color:var(--axis); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--s1); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-icon-btn:active { background:var(--surface-solid); }

components.name: Refresh Control
components.description: Read-only refresh action whose state can move from idle to loading or success.
components.css: .ds-refresh { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; min-height:34px; padding:6px 11px; border:1px solid var(--ring); border-radius:5px; background:var(--surface-solid); color:var(--ink-2); font:700 12px/1.5 "Trebuchet MS",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-refresh-icon { width:15px; height:15px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-refresh:hover { color:var(--ink); border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--s1) 40%,var(--ring)); } .ds-refresh:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--s1); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-refresh:active { background:var(--surface-2); }

components.name: Truth Rail Node
components.description: One of the four explicit PAPER/read-only/authorization/cadence contract nodes.
components.html: External authorizationTESTNET BLOCKEDPAPER qualification is not permission
components.css: .ds-truth-node { position:relative; min-height:74px; padding:12px 13px 11px 18px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--ring); border-radius:7px; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 5%,transparent); } .ds-truth-node::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:auto 0 0; height:1px; background:var(--crit); opacity:.75; } .ds-truth-wire { position:absolute; left:8px; top:12px; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--crit); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--crit-bg); } .ds-truth-label { display:block; color:var(--muted); font:700 9px/1.2 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-truth-node strong { display:block; margin-top:7px; color:var(--crit); font:700 15px/1.2 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-truth-node small { display:block; margin-top:2px; color:var(--muted); font:400 10px/1.25 "Trebuchet MS",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; }

components.name: Instrument Card
components.description: Opaque dashboard instrument plane with a semantic top rule and compact metric content.
components.html:
Operational pulse

Four signals that matter during monitoring.

PAPER / READ ONLY
components.css: .ds-card { padding:18px 19px; border:1px solid var(--ring); border-radius:7px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 5%,transparent); } .ds-card h2 { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; margin:0; color:var(--ink); font:700 12px/1.3 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing:.09em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-card-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--s2); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--s2) 12%,transparent); } .ds-card-note { margin:4px 0 13px; color:var(--muted); font:400 11.5px/1.4 "Trebuchet MS",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-card-value { display:block; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px solid var(--datum-grid); color:var(--ink); font:700 16px/1.2 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--s1) 34%,var(--ring)); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--s1) 16%,transparent); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--s1); outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
TANDEM is a dense, read-only operator cockpit: a system of forces held in visible balance. The visual world is code-led and structural, with carbon-black planes, teal signal surfaces, pale datum rails, and red tension accents. The first scan is intentionally operational: PAPER truth, read-only provenance, and blocked external authorization sit on a four-node rail before the dashboard asks the operator to interpret performance.

The dark expression is the signature control-room mode (`#090f12` field with layered teal-black surfaces). A deliberately pale-paper counterpart is available through the existing light theme for bright environments; it keeps the same geometry, rails, labels, and semantic accents. Surfaces are opaque and quiet rather than glassy. Depth comes from inset rules, one-pixel datum lines, and restrained state color. SVG controls and charts are part of the instrument panel, not decorative chrome. The direction contract is the assignment 4 / seed `e7f8d8f0` tensegrity world recorded in the first body child of `dashboard/index.html`.
keyCharacteristics: Code-led operational labels: compact monospace uppercase labels, tabular numerals, and visible `//` eyebrow markers.
Tensegrity rails: pale datum lines and small anchor dots connect the truth rail and semantic state changes.
Flat/inset depth: opaque planes, thin borders, and inset top rules carry hierarchy; shadows are reserved for overlays.
Explicit trust states: PAPER, LECTURE SEULE, and TESTNET BLOQUÉ remain distinct and visible.
Restrained motion: local control transitions and reduced-motion fallbacks support scanning without spectacle.

rules.name: The Trust-First Rule
rules.body: The four truth nodes precede interpretation: keep PAPER, read-only, testnet-blocked, and causal cadence visible in the first scan.

rules.name: The Signal-Rarity Rule
rules.body: Teal, mint, amber, and red are semantic wires. Keep their large fills rare; let thin rules, anchor dots, badges, and state copy carry most of the signal.

rules.name: The Terminal-Label Rule
rules.body: Labels name the instrument; values carry the reading. Use compact uppercase mono for operational metadata and reserve body type for explanation.

rules.name: The View-Order Rule
rules.body: Reordering a view changes scan priority, not product truth: Monitor foregrounds pulse and engine state, Performance foregrounds realized results and history, and Risk foregrounds radar, exposure, and authorization context.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not make an instrument card float. Use opaque tonal layers, datum lines, and inset rules; reserve ambient shadow for drawer and modal boundaries.

rules.name: The Rail-Over-Glow Rule
rules.body: A state must remain legible when decorative effects are disabled. The WebGL field, if enabled, sits behind the UI and never carries the sole meaning of a state.

dos: Do show the PAPER, read-only, and testnet-blocked contract before performance interpretation.
Do use the dark carbon-black/teal expression as the signature world and preserve the same roles in the pale-paper theme.
Do use compact monospace labels, tabular numerals, semantic top rules, and one-pixel datum rails to make dense state scannable.
Do keep red for tension/blocking/critical risk and amber for warning/qualification/unknown; make the distinction explicit in copy.
Do preserve non-color meaning through text, badges, symbols, and SVG legend treatments.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion`: the canvas, tilt, pulses, and local transitions must have a quiet fallback.
Do keep chart, table, drawer, and modal content bounded on mobile; the dashboard is an always-on cockpit that must remain useful at phone widths.
donts: Don't imply live authorization, venue execution, wallets, trading actions, or testnet permission anywhere in the visual system.
Don't turn the dashboard into a generic rounded glass card wall, soft gradient brand page, or decorative hero.
Don't use glow, motion, or a background canvas as the only indicator of health, risk, freshness, or authorization.
Don't flatten PAPER, stale, unknown, unavailable, realized, modeled, and backtest states into one generic status color.
Don't spend the red accent on ordinary decoration; it marks tension that can break the balance.
Don't introduce large corner radii, heavy floating shadows, or broad gradients into standard instrument cards.
Don't replace the causal 4h decision cadence or provenance notes with a more convenient but less truthful summary.
